extracted.intended_audience: Authors preparing and submitting manuscripts to the Canadian Journal of Mathematics
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions and requirements for authors submitting a final manuscript to the Canadian Journal of Mathematics via the publisher's online submission system. Covers file format, account/login requirements, required agreements, and use of ORCID identifiers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submit manuscript in final form
rubrics_metrics.description: When the manuscript is in its final form, it should be submitted online, in PDF form, by clicking the 'Submit your article' link here.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only submit the manuscript when it is in its final form. The required submission format is PDF. The page provides a 'Submit your article' link (proceeding to the partner submission system) to complete submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the partner submission system (EditFlow) and have an account
rubrics_metrics.description: We partner with a secure submission system to handle manuscript submissions. You will need an account for the submission system, which is separate to your Cambridge Core account.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The EditFlow service is used to manage communications between the editors and authors. For login and submission support, authors should visit the submission and support pages. The submission-system account is distinct from any Cambridge Core account.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review the journal's author instructions and preparing materials page
rubrics_metrics.description: Please review this journal's author instructions, particularly the preparing your materials page, before submitting your manuscript.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors are explicitly asked to consult the journal's author instructions and the preparing your materials page to ensure submission meets journal requirements prior to using the submission link.

rubrics_metrics.name: Signed copyright transfer agreement required before publication
rubrics_metrics.description: Before Cambridge can publish your manuscript, we need a signed copyright transfer agreement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Full details are provided on the publishing agreement page. A signed agreement is a precondition to publication (i.e., required after acceptance and before publication).

rubrics_metrics.name: ORCID iD is encouraged (optional)
rubrics_metrics.description: We encourage authors to identify themselves using ORCID when submitting a manuscript to this journal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ORCID provides a unique identifier for researchers and offers benefits including increased discoverability, convenience (linking activities across systems), and a place to keep validated information about research activities and affiliations. Authors who do not have an ORCID can register at https://ORCID.org/register. Use of ORCID is encouraged but not mandatory.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use ORCID 'Published Name' field to communicate how you wish to be addressed
rubrics_metrics.description: ORCIDs can also be used if authors wish to communicate to readers up-to-date information about how they wish to be addressed or referred to (for example, they wish to include pronouns, additional titles, honorifics, name variations, etc.) alongside their published articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors are encouraged to use the ORCID profile's 'Published Name' field for this purpose. This is entirely optional. The page also notes that ORCID is not currently recommended as the method for author name changes on already published articles — see Cambridge’s author name change policy for that situation.
